missing_quote_path_guard_before_performa.policy: Retainallmodeledpaths/returnsbutcountunobservedminutesduringholds. A gap may be closed market or absent feed; do not infer which. Any gap in any valid direction outcome prevents a complete-path evidence pass.

fair_random_direction_control.interpretation: Conditional random-policy benchmark rank; not a formal exchangeable permutation p-value.

long_bias_control.interpretation: Conditional random-policy benchmark rank; not a formal exchangeable permutation p-value.

weekly_block_bootstrap.unit: calendar week, grouped by trade exit, including zero-trade weeks
weekly_block_bootstrap.limitation: Intervals require at least two calendar and two nonempty weekly blocks. Two blocks are only a computational safeguard, not adequate evidence; few blocks give imprecise intervals, and days and trades are not assumed independent.

all_available_direction_outcomes.aggregation_note: Unobserved minutes are summed separately across direction paths; overlapping calendar minutes are counted again, not reported as unique global missing minutes.

holding_diagnostics.random_control_note: Per-trajectory holding counts are not stored by the immutable kernel. Every selected direction outcome already includes the same declared financing across all crossed UTC midnights; available-path counts are not executed-control trade counts.

costs.spread: Actual paired bid/ask opening and exit-side candle prices

financing.units: Declared static USD per lot, not actual historical provider rates
financing.rollover_clock: UTC midnight, charging previous weekday's multiplier
financing.note: Static USD-per-lot daily financing assumptions borrowed from the prior study snapshot; Wednesdaytriple. These are NOT verified2023providerhistoricalrates. Apply across every crossedUTCmidnight, including delayed daily closes; reportovernightpositions.

execution.price_data: HistData actual paired tick quotes aggregated to bid/ask M1; UTC modeled scenario
execution.quote_bounds: Actual first/last quote times, quantized to whole seconds by the immutable kernel; no fabricated :00/:59 tick endpoints
execution.period_end: Forced modeled settlement at the last observed pre-boundary quote, explicitly counted
execution.price_precision: Provider entry/exit quotes are retained at decoded precision; only protective levels are rounded to the declared .01 tick/digits=2 grid. No original-broker executability of finer quotes is asserted.

limitations: Provider UTC candles and numeric hours are not assumed physically equivalent to the original broker's unknown-offset clock.
M1 OHLC does not reveal intraminute ordering; same-minute stop/target uses adverse stop priority and target gaps receive no favorable improvement.
Contract, margin, financing and quoted-minute execution are virtual scenario assumptions, not verified provider executable specifications.
Random-direction ranks condition on strategy-generated opportunity timing and are not a formal exchangeable experiment or probabilities of future profit.
Closed-balance drawdown excludes floating equity excursions.
A secondary favorable result cannot replace the predeclared primary; historical passes require further untouched validation.

Unobserved quote minutes cannot establish the intervening price path. Any affected available direction outcome makes the scenario inconclusive regardless of numeric performance gates; no trade is dropped or repriced.

data_fidelity.observation_unit: UTC quote-minute presence over each inclusive holding-minute span
data_fidelity.scope: Every valid long/short direction outcome, including alternatives not executed by the actual policy
data_fidelity.gap_classification: None: absent quote minutes may reflect market closure, feed gaps or another cause
data_fidelity.execution_selection: All modeled trades and returns retained; coverage diagnostics never filter or change an execution
data_fidelity.limitation: Zero absent minutes is necessary for this gate, not proof of a complete tick path or known intraminute ordering.
